name: Baldwin-1
summary: Our NASA Student Launch 2027 vehicle. Single stage, three sections tethered through descent, one central avionics bay. The payload uses a camera ring and LiDAR rangefinding to find a passive visual target after landing, without GPS.
imageAlt: Rendered side view of the Baldwin-1 rocket design
note: OpenRocket simulation with the L1940X placeholder motor. Motor not yet selected. PDR design baseline, Oct 2026.

name: ME-B26
summary: The team's single-seat off-road vehicle for the Baja SAE series: tubular steel frame, suspension, steering, braking and drivetrain, designed and fabricated by students.
imageAlt: A member welding at a steel fixture table in the shop
